listen_addresses.description: Host names or IP addresses to listen on for client connections (use '*' for all).

port.description: Port number on which pgpool accepts connections.

socket_directories.description: Unix socket directory; leave empty for system default.

num_init_children.description: Number of child processes to handle client connections.

reserved_connections.description: Number of connections reserved for superusers.

connection_cache_size.description: Number of backend connection caches per child process.

health_check_period.description: Interval (in seconds) between health checks of PostgreSQL nodes.

health_check_timeout.description: Maximum time (in seconds) to wait for health check response.

backends.description: List of PostgreSQL backend nodes to proxy.

hostname.description: Host name or IP address of the PostgreSQL node.

data_directory.description: Data directory on the backend node (used for failover detection).

enable_pool_hba.description: Enable pool_hba.conf-based client authentication (recommended for production).

ssl_cert.description: Path to SSL certificate file (PEM format).

ssl_key.description: Path to SSL private key file.

ssl_ca_cert.description: Path to SSL CA certificate file.

ssl_ca_cert_dir.description: Directory containing trusted SSL CA certificates.

log_line_prefix.description: Format for log line prefix (like PostgreSQL).

log_hostname.description: Log client host name (adds DNS lookup overhead).

log_statement.description: Log all SQL statements (use with care in production).

log_per_node_statement.description: Log SQL statements per backend node.

use_watchdog.description: Enable watchdog for high availability (requires additional config).

wd_hostname.description: Hostname for watchdog communication (used only if `use_watchdog` is enabled).

replication_mode.description: Enable replication mode (duplicates writes to all backends).

load_balance_mode.description: Enable load balancing for read queries.

slot_name.description: Replication slot name (used in streaming replication mode).

failover_when_quorum_exists.description: Allow automatic failover only if watchdog quorum is present.

failover_require_consensus.description: Require consensus among watchdogs for failover decisions.

health_check_user.description: PostgreSQL user used for health checks (must have REPLICATION privilege).

health_check_password.description: Password for health check user (use secure credential storage).

ssl_mode.description: SSL mode for backend connections: 'disable', 'allow', 'prefer', or 'require'.
